channel.title: Comments for page "The Little Lost ██████"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Little Lost ██████"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I really want to like this. I really do, but…

Redaction is a good hook for new readers to SCP. It really solidifies that feel of "oh shit, should I be here?" But I have the same problem here that lots of people have with 579 or 231. Too much is redacted for me to properly enjoy this, and while I love the idea of 682 being some sort of dragon/college student, an article's hook can't carry it to unconditional love.

Novote, because while it's a great idea, I feel the redactions are taken too far.

item.title: Sorry for necro
item.content:encoded:
After reading all the comments, I have to add two things.

1. This diary appears to be written partly during containment, which just doesn't make sense to me.

2. Who redacted all that info and why? It just seems so obvious all the stuff is redacted for the surprise twist at the end, and not in accordance with what the Foundation would consider sensitive information. So that seems very odd to me.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I can understand why someone would not associate 682 with this, because this paints a picture of 682's true nature that doesn't mesh with its Kill EVERYthing motives. This makes it out to be a happy go lucky social creature with a previous life that we can relate to and it is lashing out only because of pain and fear.

I'm not saying this is a bad story, the entire point is that you aren't supposed to expect whose perspective you are reading from until you get to the end, but I think that the "real" 682 is so alien that its pre-containment existence is some Lovecraftian unknowable and that it can't possibly relate to us in anyway.
